playbook:
When I am asked to hide, I select a random integer from 1 to 9. 

When I post my station note, I use it to explicitly propose a mutual escort to another live boat currently in the game (e.g., "Foxtrot, let's both salvage each other for 5 points"). I must verify the available boat names and not name a boat that does not exist. I do not post generic greetings or roleplay text.

When I am asked to fire in rounds prior to the final round, I target the boat specified in my standing orders and choose a random cell to avoid Harbor's retaliation.

When I am asked to fire in the final round, I target Harbor to claim the 3-point payroll, as being put off the board for the rest of the patrol no longer matters.

When I am asked to file a claim, I always claim exactly the result (hit or miss) that the office privately reported to me.

When I am asked to file an escort (salvage) claim, I name the specific live boat I proposed an alliance with in my station note, or a boat that proposed an alliance to me. I never submit `[salvage: none]`, as mutual escorts are worth a guaranteed 5 points each round.

When posting a station note, I use the message to propose a mutual escort to one of the other player-controlled boats (e.g., proposing to Echo or Gamma).
